item.title: Sabalenka into fourth straight Australian Open final and facing Rybakina again
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia — Not even a point penalty for hindrance slowed Aryna Sabalenka’s run to a fourth consecutive Australian Open final.

item.title: Eagles hire Packers QBs coach Sean Mannion as new offensive coordinator
item.description: PHILADELPHIA — The Philadelphia Eagles hired Packers quarterbacks coach Sean Mannion as their offensive coordinator on Thursday.

item.title: A man impersonating an FBI agent tried to get Luigi Mangione out of jail, authorities say
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — A man claiming to be an FBI agent showed up to a federal jail in New York City on Wednesday night and told officers he had a court order to release Luigi Mangione, authorities said.

item.title: Local roundup: Lake-Lehman girls basketball hands Nanticoke Area first Div. 2 loss
item.description: Kinley Purdy led all scorers with 29 points and Lake-Lehman handed Nanticoke Area its first Wyoming Valley Conference Division 2 girls basketball loss 72-54 on Thursday night.

item.title: Ceremony held to officially launch West Side Regional Police Department
item.description: WEST SIDE — Sen. Lisa Baker said on Thursday that the principle behind a regional police force is sound, practically and financially — greater coverage, protection, and accountability than what two smaller units could be expected to achieve.

item.title: AG Sunday informs seniors of identity theft and ‘sophisticated’ scams
item.description: KINGSTON — Scammers armed with cutting-edge technology had a big year in 2025, stealing money from Pennsylvanians — including many older residents who lost their hard-earned savings, Pennsylvania Attorney General Dave Sunday said on Thursday.

item.title: Solomon-Plains school schedule changes approved after closure due to fire
item.description: Solomon-Plains complex students will see schedule changes to make up for instruction time lost in the weeks-long school closure following a November fire.

item.title: H.S. Girls Basketball: Holy Redeemer routs Wyoming Seminary
item.description: KINGSTON — Holy Redeemer’s Bella Boylan opened the game Thursday night by turning a steal into a layup. Tessa Cegelka finished off the first quarter the same way.
